T: Bartertown rules apply. Trade you a chip for a dip.
D: Max ends up in Bartertown and its fight to the death arena.
P: Serve the mains when the Thunderdome match begins.
S: Dates stuffed with goat's cheese and almond, dried figs, cheddar and crackers
Medjool dates stuffed with goat's cheese and a toasted almond, dried figs halved, aged cheddar in shards and crackers, all laid out on a rough board like a market stall.
Salted pork rind roasted until blistered and shattering, with a sharp apple and mustard dip

Strips of pork rind salted and dried overnight, roasted until blistered and shatteringly crisp, with a sharp apple and mustard dipping sauce. Score 800g pork rind, rub with 1 tbsp salt and leave uncovered in the fridge overnight. Pat dry, cut into strips and roast on a rack at 240C for 30 minutes until blistered, then rest. Simmer 2 peeled, chopped apples with 2 tbsp sugar and 50ml water for 10 minutes and mash, then stir in 1 tbsp wholegrain mustard and a splash of cider vinegar. Break the crackling into shards and serve with the sauce.
Blistered yoghurt flatbread with oil and dukkah to dip. Worth a pig's worth of methane.

Mix 300g self-raising flour with 250g Greek yoghurt and a pinch of salt into a soft dough. Divide into 6, roll thin and cook in a dry hot pan for 2 minutes a side until blistered. Brush with olive oil and serve with dukkah and more oil to dip.
M: Spiced shoulder slow roasted and pulled, soft buns and slaw, while Max's camels wait outside

Pork shoulder rubbed with paprika and brown sugar, roasted low until it pulls apart, piled into soft rolls with tangy slaw and barbecue sauce. Rub a 2kg pork shoulder with 2 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 1 tbsp salt and 1 tsp garlic powder. Roast covered at 150C for 5 hours until it pulls apart, then shred with the pan juices. Toss half a shredded cabbage and 1 grated carrot with 100g mayonnaise and 1 tbsp cider vinegar. Fill 8 soft rolls with pork, slaw and 150ml barbecue sauce.
Garlic and rosemary lamb leg with roast potatoes and homemade mint sauce

Lamb leg studded with garlic and rosemary, rubbed with oil and salt, roasted at 180C until 58C in the thickest part, rested 20 minutes, sliced, with a fresh mint sauce of chopped mint, sugar, vinegar and boiling water.
W: Craggy currant rock cakes with a sugar crust. Two men enter, one man leaves with the last one.

Heat the oven to 190C. Rub 125g butter into 300g self-raising flour, then stir in 100g sugar, 100g currants and 1 tsp mixed spice. Mix in 1 egg and 4 tbsp milk to a stiff dough. Drop rough heaps on a lined tray, sprinkle with sugar and bake 15 minutes until golden.
K: Fresh ginger syrup, lemon and soda water, no alcohol

A quick homemade ginger beer of fresh ginger, lemon and brown sugar syrup topped with soda, fiery and cloudy, served over ice with lime. Grate 100g fresh ginger and simmer with 150g brown sugar and 300ml water for 10 minutes. Cool, then strain, pressing hard on the ginger. Stir in the juice of 2 lemons. Divide the syrup between 4 tall glasses of ice and top each with 200ml cold soda water. Stir and add a lime wedge and a thin slice of ginger.
